dataList.content:
While the rest of the Sinners were slowly recovering from the excitement of battle, Don Quixote did not waste a second before bolting forth to the woman's side.
当其他罪人正从战斗的余波中重整态势时，堂吉诃德如闪电般冲向了倒在地上的人身边。

Hark! Art thou— Ah, I must check thy pulse...
那什么！啊，吾得给汝把把脉……

Ooh~ You can check her pulse through her forehead? Didn't know that was possible~
哦~你能通过额头把脉啊，还有这种把脉方式吗？

Mhm! The lady lives!
嗯！还活着呢！

Haah... so this lass has the intel we need?
哈……所以这家伙手上有我们需要的情报？

The Sinners one by one began to gather around the woman.
罪人们一个个地聚集到了倒地者的身边。

She was dressed in an all-black garb like the Kurokumo Clan members, but her weapon and her outfit were unmistakably distinct.
虽然一身黑的衣服与黑云会的没什么区别……但可以看出她所持的武器和服装与黑云会的有着微妙的不同。

<Blade Lineage, huh...>
<是叫剑契组来着吧……>

I looked around at the defeated Kurokumo Clan members, then back at her. The difference became even more apparent.
我环顾四周后，感到的差异就更加明显。

Don Quixote slowly and tragically shook her head after checking the pulse on others.
堂吉诃德在为其他倒在地上的人把完脉后悲伤地缓缓摇了摇头。

Executive Manager. I have questioned some Kurokumo Clan members during the battle, but no notable intelligence has been gained.
执行经理。我在战斗中审问了几名黑云会成员，但并未获得任何有价值的情报。

<So it's just her, then... I hope my gut feelings prove me right.>
<那就只有她了啊……希望我的直觉是对的。>

The lady doth appear to be the sole survivor... We must move her to the bus and administer first aid posthaste. What dost thou say to that?
看来这位小姐是唯一的幸存者……总之先把此人带回巴士上进行急救如何？

<... Yeah. Don't see any other way.>
<……嗯。这应该是最优解。>

We don't carry a first aid kit with us and I can't turn the clock to heal her, so...
我们并没有携带急救设备，我也无法通过转动时钟来治愈她。

<Meursault? Do you mind carrying her back to the bus?>
<默尔索，将这个人带回巴士上。拜托了。>

I do not.
我明白了。

Thus we made our way back to the bus, Meursault carrying the dying Blade Lineage member.
就这样，我们带着奄奄一息的剑契组成员回到了巴士上。

I see that you've hauled in another baggage.
看来你们又带了些行李回来啊。

dataList.content:
... Vergilius didn't seem very happy about this.
……维吉里乌斯沉闷地说道。

Manager... since when did bringing in unauthorized, unverified 'guests' into our bus become such an... acceptable practice?
经理……从什么时候开始允许未经授权的客人进入巴士变得理所当然了？

<We had no choice... We have to save her first if we're going to get any answers out of her.>
<我们别无选择……总之，如果想从她嘴里问出点东西，就得先救活她才行。>

Dante explains that this individual will be of no use to us deceased. If she carries the intel we need, then we must first ensure that she survives.
其认为，应当率先对可能知晓我们所需情报的人进行救治。

On that, Faust agrees with Dante's decision.
浮士德同样对此表示赞同。

Hah, what's done is done. However, do be mindful of bringing in strangers onto this bus from now on, Dante.
哈，既然木已成舟，那就这样吧。但以后请继续保持警惕，但丁。

I had a feeling that Vergilius had much more to say than that, but he simply sighed and dropped the subject.
我感觉他还想再说些什么，但维吉里乌斯只是叹了口气，便不再多说了。

I-I believe that Manager Esquire hath made a decision most just.
吾、吾相信经理老爷的决定是正确的。

<Mmh, thanks...>
<嗯，谢谢……>

Just as I was starting to dread that this bus was doomed to be eternally uncomfortable, Yi Sang emerged from the Backdoor with good news.
就在我认为这股尴尬的气氛会在巴士上萦绕直至永恒时，李箱从后门中走出，向我缓缓靠近。

I have done what I can. Now—
治疗措施已全部完成。现在……

And before he even finished his sentence...
然后，在他说完这句话之前。
